title: 4/12 no live scorecard for a cross-game double (Preview outranked Live in the merge); the scorecard header never rendered

contract.text: The live scorecard renders whenever any leg's game is live, with a header showing status and score.

mechanism.text: merge_scorecards (as changed by 0ba01e1 on 4/06) kept the higher value of {F:0, L:1, P:2}, so a Preview primary beat a Live double-down; render_scorecard_section returns '' unless the status is L or F, so /api/live-html stayed empty
render_scorecard_section built the live badge, score and inning strings but never inserted them into its HTML (dead code)
